newsitem.title: FINLAND: PANOSTAJA SEES FULL-YR PROFIT UP CLEARLY.
newsitem.headline: PANOSTAJA SEES FULL-YR PROFIT UP CLEARLY.

text.p: Finnish investment company Panostaja Oy said on Wednesday its profit for its full 1996/97 financial year to end October would be clearly higher than the 95/96 profit when it made a profit after financial items of 7.8 million markka.

"The profitability of the Panostaja group is expected to develop favourably also at the end of the year, and the profit for the full financial period is ... expected to clearly exceed the profit for the previous year," Panostaja said in a statement with its six-month results.
